text: {"lessons":["Holding is still a decision: my account fell 6.8% in one month without a trade, so I'll check whether my positions still fit my risk tolerance.","Two months of gains didn't prevent the next month's loss, so I won't assume a short rebound will continue.","I'll trade only when my reasons for owning a stock change or its position size no longer fits my plan, not just because the account had a bad month."]}
